components.css: .ds-card{font-family:var(--font-body, Inter),sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-decoration:none;overflow-wrap:anywhere;border:1px solid var(--line, #c4d1d6);background:var(--paper, #fff);color:var(--ink, #001f29);padding:28px;line-height:1.5;}.ds-card h2{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 16px;text-wrap:pretty;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}.ds-card time{display:block;margin-top:16px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted, #455f68);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-card p{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted, #455f68);}.ds-card-action{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:28px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;}.ds-card-action svg{transition:transform 160ms ease-out;}.ds-card:hover{border-color:var(--ink, #001f29);}.ds-card:hover h2{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:2px;text-underline-offset:5px;}.ds-card:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px);}.ds-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #006b9e);outline-offset:4px;}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-card{padding:24px;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-card-action svg{transition:none;}.ds-card:hover svg{transform:none;}}

narrative.overview:
This system records the static public events application only. Its visual authority is the user-supplied Sea-Watch website (https://sea-watch.org/): the official locally served mark, navy and cyan fields, white content surfaces, and locally served Inter. It does not establish a visual system for the private CRM.

The implementation is flat and direct. Bold headings establish hierarchy; labelled filters, bordered event cards and restrained metadata support catalogue browsing. Detail pages retain the same header, footer, typography and controls. These are implemented source rules, not evidence of production deployment.
keyCharacteristics: Official Sea-Watch mark and existing identity.
Navy framing, cyan title field and white working surfaces.
Locally served Inter in regular and bold weights.
Square controls, fine borders and flat panels.
Responsive grids and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Public Events Scope Rule
rules.body: Apply this record within the static public events application; the private CRM has separate visual authority.

rules.name: The Two Weight Rule
rules.body: Use the locally served regular and bold Inter files for body text and emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with borders, spacing and background fields rather than shadows.

dos: Do preserve the official locally served Sea-Watch mark and supplied brand identity.
Do use the recorded regular and bold Inter files and responsive heading sizes.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, text labels, wrapping content and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep metadata quieter than event titles and preserve clear registration states.
donts: Don't carry this public events identity into the private CRM without a separate request.
Don't reintroduce the replaced cream-and-green gradients or rounded floating panels.
Don't substitute a generated logo or decorative concept imagery for the supplied identity.
